verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 'Secret variables in environments' which masks secret values in shared environments, directly addressing keeping credentials out of shared files. However, there is no evidence of an external vault integration (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) — only local secret-variable masking is documented. Missing for 10: external vault/secrets-manager integration, independent verification that masked secrets are excluded from exported/shared collection files, and confirmation this works in self-hosted/team contexts.
